name: CrossTalk
summary: Two teams race to guess a secret keyword using one private clue and alternating public one-word clues.
rules_text: Split into two teams, each with a clue-giver. Both clue-givers jointly see a secret Keyword card. Each writes a one-word private clue for only their team. Then clue-givers alternate writing one-word public clues on a shared board. After each public clue, only the opposing team may make one guess at the Keyword. Each team gets at most 4 public clues and 5 guesses per round. A private Hint Board with symbols can be used once per round after your team's guess to secretly modify clue interpretation. First team to 5 correct guesses wins. Clue restrictions: single real English word, not always capitalized, not contained in or homophone of Keyword, no acronyms, no extra communication.
rating_reason: Team word clue guessing, hidden keywords, perfect for text talk and bluffing
